name: comp-304
title: Announcement Banner
blurb: Dark announcement banner with icon, message, and learn more link.
description: Full-width dark-themed announcement banner with eclipse icon, feature message, and Learn more link with hover arrow animation.
use_when: You need to announce a new feature prominently with a dark aesthetic.
avoid_when: For persistent, dismissible announcements; use comp-305 or comp-306 instead.
a11y: Icon is aria-hidden. Link is keyboard accessible. No animation.
